acceptance.meaning: Passing verify covers executed gates only; first-release acceptance and external evidence are recorded in ACCEPTANCE.md.

setup.effects: Run remote type and product checks, provision or reuse the named D1, write ignored environment-specific Worker configuration, and apply remote migrations without publishing the Worker or initializing the owner.

deploy.effects: Run remote checks, provision or reuse D1, build and validate the emitted Worker, apply migrations, upload with temporary private secrets, wait for /health, and initialize or verify the existing owner.

verify.effects: Run typechecking, Hono and real SQLite tests, isolated helper transport tests, a fresh Worker/D1/Chromium journey, and a production build; this is bounded implementation evidence.

authentication: Remote setup and deployment require CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN for the selected account, plus the owner credentials and first-owner H2H_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN. Optional SendGrid values must be supplied together and are uploaded through a temporary private secrets file.

configuration.description: Declares HappyToHelp's bootstrap, origin, optional mail, and deployment environment inputs.
Tracked local Worker and D1 configuration; remote setup writes an ignored environment-specific configuration beneath .wrangler/h2h-deployment.
Remote/local target rules, owner inputs, origin routing, secret handling, and deployment behavior.
Ignored generated remote Worker configuration selected by H2H_DEPLOY_ENV.

health.meaning: Checks that the Worker can execute a D1 SELECT and returns the HappyToHelp service status. It does not verify owner bootstrap, agent workspace effects, mail delivery, or connected tools.

notes: HappyToHelp requires an explicit target: use -- --local or -- --remote. The H2H_DEPLOY_MODE environment value is an equivalent selector for the Base CLI when no command target is supplied.
Optional SENDGRID_API_KEY and MAIL_FROM must be supplied together. Missing mail transport leaves approved replies pending and visible.
Deployment initializes or verifies an owner after health; it does not execute customer work or agent instructions.
verify covers executed local gates only and does not establish business-workspace mutation evidence, mailbox delivery, full accessibility/capacity acceptance, or the obligations in ACCEPTANCE.md.
The operations check is read-only static local input validation. It does not inspect Cloudflare, generated caches, build output, migration state, or hosted health.
